title: Sign in with email and password
description: A user can sign in through the password path and reach the authenticated app.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth/signin
Click the 'Use password' option to reveal the email and password fields
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Verify the user lands in the authenticated app (an organization workspace or dashboard is shown, not the sign-in form)

title: Invalid password shows a sign-in error
description: Signing in with a wrong password is rejected and an error is shown.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth/signin
Click the 'Use password' option to reveal the email and password fields
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with the clearly wrong value 'definitely-not-the-password'
Submit the sign-in form
Verify an invalid-credentials error message is shown and the user remains on the sign-in page

title: Signed-out user is redirected from a protected workspace
description: Visiting a protected organization route while signed out redirects to sign-in.

steps.description: Navigate to /orgs/does-not-matter/thumbnails while not signed in
Verify the app redirects to the sign-in page instead of rendering the protected workspace

title: Sign out returns the user to a signed-out state
description: An authenticated user can sign out and is returned to a public/sign-in surface.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth/signin
Click the 'Use password' option to reveal the email and password fields
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Open the user/account menu (usually the avatar or account button)
Click the Sign out option
Verify the user is signed out (the landing or sign-in surface is shown and protected content is no longer accessible)

title: Organization dashboard loads with the sidebar navigation
description: After signing in, the organization workspace renders with its sidebar groups and links.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth/signin
Click the 'Use password' option to reveal the email and password fields
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Verify the left sidebar shows the Thumbnails group (Dashboard, Thumbnails, Generations) and the Resources group (Persons, Inspirations, Images, Videos)

title: Open the Persons resource page
description: The Persons page is reachable from the sidebar and renders its content.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth/signin
Click the 'Use password' option to reveal the email and password fields
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Click the 'Persons' link in the sidebar Resources group
Verify the Persons page loads (a persons list or an empty-state prompting to add a person is shown), without an error screen

title: Open the Inspirations resource page
description: The Inspirations page is reachable and renders.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth/signin
Click the 'Use password' option to reveal the email and password fields
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Click the 'Inspirations' link in the sidebar Resources group
Verify the Inspirations page loads with either a grid of inspirations or an empty state, without an error screen

title: Open the Videos resource page
description: The Videos page is reachable and renders.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth/signin
Click the 'Use password' option to reveal the email and password fields
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Click the 'Videos' link in the sidebar Resources group
Verify the Videos page loads with either a videos list or an empty state, without an error screen

title: View the account page
description: The account page loads and shows the signed-in user's profile information.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth/signin
Click the 'Use password' option to reveal the email and password fields
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Navigate to /account
Verify the account page shows the signed-in user's profile details (for example the account email {{LOGIN_USER}})

title: Update the organization name in settings
description: An org admin can rename the organization and the new name is reflected after saving.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth/signin
Click the 'Use password' option to reveal the email and password fields
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Open the organization settings page
Change the organization name field to 'TS Verify Org'
Save the organization settings
Verify a success confirmation appears and the organization name now reads 'TS Verify Org' (in the settings field and/or the org switcher/header)

title: Admin feature flags table shows declared flags as switches
description: The admin Feature Flags page always lists the declared flags (generation routing, Thumbnail Agent, free-plan watermark) with short descriptions and toggle switches.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth/signin
Click the 'Use password' option to reveal the email and password fields
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Navigate to /admin/feature-flags

Verify the table lists three rows - 'Generation routing: APIYI first', 'Thumbnail Agent (beta)', and 'Free-plan watermark' - each with a single short one-line description and a toggle switch control (not an Enable/Disable text button) that is fully visible without being cut off

title: Enabling the Thumbnail Agent flag shows the Agent link
description: When the thumbnail-agent flag is enabled, the Agent (Beta) link appears in the organization sidebar.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth/signin
Click the 'Use password' option to reveal the email and password fields
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Navigate to /admin/feature-flags
Ensure the 'Thumbnail Agent (beta)' switch is turned on (toggle it on if it is currently off)
Open an organization workspace the user owns
Verify the left sidebar, under the Thumbnails group, shows an 'Agent' navigation link with a 'Beta' badge

title: Admin users list page loads
description: A platform admin can open the admin Users page and see the users list.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth/signin
Click the 'Use password' option to reveal the email and password fields
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Navigate to /admin/users
Verify the admin Users page loads and shows a list/table of users including the signed-in admin account, without an error screen
